scope: Diagnose and recover the frozen TG2 exact-rank-data-order invariant before any retraining decision

observed_failure.issue: All nine training jobs completed, but exact rank data-order digests differ across arms within the same training seed. The admitted loader used eight workers per rank and in_order=false, so worker completion order could enter the audited sequence.

probe_contract.acceptance: The episode_index/frame_index SHA-256 digest must match rank-by-rank across both independent launches.

invariants: The probe imports the frozen TG2 dataset builder, collator, and Accelerate sharding path.
No model is built or trained, no checkpoint is written, and no probe output is admissible as paper evidence.
The failed nine-arm TG2 matrix and all nine evaluations remain blocked regardless of probe outcome.
A failed probe forbids deterministic TG2 retraining until another recovery design is admitted.

validation.unit_test: Matching four-rank records pass and a single-rank digest mutation fails.
